packageRules.description: Minor, patch, pin and digest automerge once CI is green. The gate is minimumReleaseAge plus a passing test run, not a human. This used to be automergeType: branch with ignoreTests: true, which merged straight to the base branch without a PR and without running anything: no PR meant no reviewer, no record and no test. A repo with no CI at all has to set ignoreTests: true for itself, because a branch with no status check and no check run resolves to yellow and would never automerge.

A major is never automerged, in any manager or repo. It requests a review instead, and that request is the notification that one is waiting. Majors are where upstream notes change what you do, so they stay a decision.
